verdict.rationale: GitLab's docs include a dedicated REST API deprecations page. It states the REST API follows semantic versioning, that breaking changes will not be made within REST API v4, and that users should review listed deprecations. A versioning-and-deprecations section and an autogenerated OpenAPI 3.0 spec tied to the API code back this up. Missing for 10: details on deprecation timelines or notice periods, coverage of non-REST APIs such as GraphQL, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the policy is honored.
